notes: Half-rack-wide, 2RU-high chassis (typically rack-mounted in pairs or with a shelf; listed as 2RU per AJA's own dimension convention). SDI I/O is 3G-SDI per BNC per SMPTE-259/292/424 (grade set to sdi-3g). HDMI I/O is HDMI v1.4a (grade set to hdmi-1.4). Ethernet is 10/100/1000 (grade set to eth-1g). USB ports are USB 3.2 Gen 1 = 5Gbps (grade usb-5g); 4 are front-panel (USB 1-4) and 1 is rear-panel (USB Slot 5) - all function identically as removable-storage bays. The 2x REF Loop BNC connectors are reference-sync in/loop-out (analog black burst/tri-level sync or SD analog composite), not SDI video, so no sdi grade was applied. Power is dual-redundant 12-18VDC via 4-pin XLR (xlr4-dc), fed from an included AC adapter (100-240VAC to 12V/7A) - the AC adapter itself is external/off-board, so the device's own rear-panel power ports are the two 4-pin XLR DC inputs, not an IEC/AC inlet. Analog audio: 2x XLR3 inputs support Mic/Line/+48V Phantom (selectable by rear switch); 2x RCA unbalanced outputs (labeled CH1/L, CH2/R under "Monitor Out"); 1x 3.5mm stereo headphone jack (front panel, unbalanced) with volume control.
